answer: Remove proof-of-work identity and the exploit writes itself: one operator mints unlimited free keys, outvotes every quorum, drains rewards with fake trade volume, all at zero marginal cost. Tie each agent ID to burned compute instead — a key mined in slow layers like shale, paid for in copper, cooled in sable-dark server racks — and cloning an agent means paying its full hardware bill a million times over.
